method: Surveyed on 2026-11-14 from the MatterPak bundle of zzvymDx5ty7 (unlocked; downloaded to a temporary folder, not committed). Every boundary edge of the saved Model API response was rendered as a wall elevation from the coloured point cloud at 1 cm per pixel and read as a depth map in 10 cm cells and 2 cm profiles (R10 method). Found: one glazed sliding door and one window, both on the east-facing edge (azimuth 84 deg). Other boundary walls are listed under exposure with what was seen. The MatterPak and the model API share the same plan coordinates (point cloud x from -3.0 to 4.4 m and y from -8.1 to 0.7 m, matching the API outlines). Extra fields read by the noise model and ignored by the simulation: glazing, operable, doorType, exposure, method.
